description: List the runners that can take a project's jobs, and say whether anything can actually run a given job. job_tags.description: Comma-separated job tags to test eligibility against. Omit for an untagged job. The verdict distinguishes no runners, all offline, and no tag match — three different fixes that GitLab renders identically as a pending job.

name: list_project_runners

description: List GitLab projects accessible to the authenticated user
name: list_projects

description: List available coding rules, optionally filtered by language.

language.description: Language filter: PHP, Kotlin, TypeScript, Ansible (empty = all)

name: list_rules

description: List tags (releases) for a project.
name: list_tags

description: List configured teams from ~/.gl-mcp/teams.json
name: list_teams

description: Merge a merge request. Optionally squash commits, remove source branch, set custom merge commit message.
name: merge_mr

description: Run a pipeline schedule immediately, so a new schedule can be proven once instead of waiting an interval to find out it was misconfigured.
name: play_pipeline_schedule

description: Rebase a merge request onto the target branch
name: rebase_mr

description: Retry a failed pipeline
name: retry_pipeline

description: Revert a commit by creating a new revert commit on the target branch.

branch.description: Target branch where the revert commit should be created

sha.description: Commit SHA to revert (full or short)

name: revert_commit

description: Revoke a project access token. Irreversible, so confirm_name must exactly equal the token's name; an id typo cannot revoke a neighbouring token.

confirm_name.description: Safety confirmation: must EXACTLY equal the token's name. Revocation is refused if it does not match.

name: revoke_project_access_token

description: Save a team to ~/.gl-mcp/teams.json (not committed to repo)

instances.description: Comma-separated instance names per user (optional, matches usernames order)

name: save_team

description: Search code in one project, or across every non-archived project in a group via group_path — for org-wide sweeps (renames, leaked strings). Returns matching file paths, line numbers, and code snippets.

full_sweep.description: Group sweeps only: cover every repo in one call instead of the default window. Costs one API call per repo — use when an empty result must actually mean absence.

group_path.description: Group path — search every (non-archived) project in the group instead of one repo. Use for org-wide sweeps (renames, leaked strings).

offset.description: Group sweeps only: skip this many repos (ordered by last activity) to continue a partial sweep. When repos remain, the response prints the exact offset to use next.

project_id.description: Project ID or path. Omit when using group_path.

query.description: Search terms. NOT a regex — GitLab matches substrings/terms, so `foo|bar` is searched literally. If an alternation query returns nothing, the tool re-runs each alternative separately and says so, because an empty result must never be mistaken for proof of absence.

name: search_code

description: Search GitLab issues across all projects, within a specific project, or within a group

group_id.description: Group ID or path to search issues within a group (e.g., 'my-org/backend')

project_id.description: Project ID or path (empty = search all projects)

state.description: Filter by state: opened, closed, all (default: opened)

name: search_issues

description: Search GitLab users by name, username, or email
name: search_users

description: Create a CI/CD variable for a project. Confirmation never includes the value. Mark sensitive values masked=true and protected=true.

masked.description: Masked variable: hidden in job logs (default: false)

protected.description: Protected variable: only exposed to protected branches/tags (default: false)

name: set_ci_variable

description: Create or update a variable on a pipeline schedule (upsert by key). The value is never echoed back.
name: set_pipeline_schedule_variable

description: Audit several specs against their repos concurrently (e.g. iOS/Android/Windows/Mac app-spec articles) and roll up into one cross-platform table: per-platform version/cleanup-debt/drift/stale-doc/undocumented/secrets, a needs-attention list, and totals. Each platform audits independently; one failure doesn't sink the rest.

label.description: Display label for the rollup (e.g. 'iOS'). Defaults to the project path.

project_id.description: Project ID or path for this platform

ref_name.description: Branch or tag to search in (default: default branch)

routes_file.description: Optional route-defining source for precise reverse-drift: a file, comma-separated files, or a directory (recursive)

spec.description: The spec document for this platform, as markdown/text

summary_only.description: Return only the rollup table (no needs-attention / totals detail).

targets.description: Platforms to audit. Each is audited independently (and concurrently); results roll up into one cross-platform table.

name: sweep_spec_audit

description: Transfer a project to a different namespace/group. `namespace` accepts a full group path like 'my-org/devops' or a numeric group id (resolved & validated). Non-destructive move — no data loss.

namespace.description: Target namespace: a full group path like 'my-org/devops' or a numeric group id. Resolved and validated before the move.

name: transfer_project

description: Update branch protection settings (delete + recreate). Access levels: 0=None, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 60=Admin.
name: update_branch_protection

description: Update an existing CI/CD variable's value and flags. Confirmation never includes the value.

masked.description: Masked variable: hidden in job logs

protected.description: Protected variable: only exposed to protected branches/tags

name: update_ci_variable

description: Create or update a file in a GitLab repo. Always commits to a new branch (never main), optionally creates MR. Use for README fixes, translations, config updates.

branch.description: Branch name to commit to (must NOT be main/master/develop)

create_mr.description: Create a merge request after commit (default: true)

source_branch.description: Source branch to create from (default: main)

name: update_file

description: Update a GitLab issue: title, description, state, labels, assignee
name: update_issue

description: Update a merge request's title, description, labels, target branch, or assignee. Only the fields you pass are changed. Assignee takes a username or id (or 'none' to unassign) and errors on an unknown username.

assignee.description: Assignee: username (leading @ optional) or numeric user id. Use 'none' to unassign. Unknown username errors (optional)

labels.description: Comma-separated labels to set, replacing existing (optional)

name: update_merge_request

description: Update a pipeline schedule (description, ref, cron, timezone, active). A new ref or cron is validated exactly as on creation — an unresolvable ref is refused instead of saved to never fire.

ref_name.description: New branch or tag — validated to resolve before the update

name: update_pipeline_schedule

description: Update project settings — CI runner toggles (shared_runners_enabled, group_runners_enabled), default branch, visibility, merge method, description. Without this a project created through this server cannot be made able to run a pipeline.

group_runners_enabled.description: Enable group runners for this project

merge_method.description: Merge method: merge, rebase_merge or ff

shared_runners_enabled.description: Enable instance-wide shared runners for this project

name: update_project

description: Validate a commit against coding rules (regex-based, zero LLM tokens). Returns only violations grouped by severity.
name: validate_commit

description: Validate all commits in a merge request against coding rules. Returns only violations.
name: validate_mr

description: Validate MR using the full unified diff (not individual commits). Catches issues in squashed MRs where commit diffs are minimal. Checks all added lines against Swift, PHP, Kotlin, Go, TypeScript, and global rules.
name: validate_mr_changes

description: Validate recent commits against message conventions (conventional commits, ticket refs, length) and code rules. Skips merge commits.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 14)

name: validate_project_commits
